says: A surface said in this observatory: the steps one can take from what is shown - each thing a line is about, once, with how to stand on it. For a shell, for a script, for anyone who walks by saying where to stand.
What is being done now, what is in progress, and what shows and has come to nothing yet: three lenses placed together, asking nothing of their own.

What is still showing, and what the whole waits on: signs nothing has come of, runs failing on main, what holds work back and by what, what waits only in words, and what would free the most once done - placed together, asking nothing of their own.
